feature: Fix lodash import pattern for proper tree-shaking
description: The InitiativeList component imports debounce using `import { debounce } from 'lodash'` which includes the entire lodash library (~70KB). Named imports from lodash don't tree-shake properly. Should use path import `import debounce from 'lodash/debounce'` or switch to a dedicated debounce package (~1KB).

phases.name: Analysis & Preparation
phases.description: Verify the lodash usage and ensure we understand the full scope of the change

subtasks.title: Confirm all lodash imports in codebase
subtasks.description: Search for any other lodash imports across the entire codebase to ensure we fix all instances
acceptance_criteria: Document which lodash functions are used
subtasks.notes: Found only ONE lodash import in the entire codebase at apps/web/src/pages/InitiativesPage/InitiativeList/InitiativeList.tsx line 6. Only the debounce function is used. Dependencies are lodash ^4.17.21 and @types/lodash ^4.17.16 in apps/web/package.json. No other lodash patterns (lodash-es, require) were found.

subtasks.title: Verify debounce API usage
subtasks.description: Confirm the debounce function usage including .cancel() method to ensure path import maintains compatibility
subtasks.notes: Verified debounce API usage: (1) debounce(fn, 300ms) creates debounced function via useMemo, (2) .cancel() method IS used in useEffect cleanup for proper unmount handling, (3) Path import 'lodash/debounce' fully supports both features - the DebouncedFunc type includes cancel() and flush() methods. TypeScript types via @types/lodash support path imports.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: Update the lodash import to use path import pattern for tree-shaking
